issues.description: Field and constructor parameter type mismatch for StockIngredient.price: The problem statement UML and the reference solution declare StockIngredient.price as an int and the constructor signature as StockIngredient(String, int, int). The template repository's StockIngredient declares the price field and constructor parameter as double (and getPrice() returns double). This inconsistency (double vs int) will confuse students and can cause compilation/type errors when students follow the UML/spec and the solution examples (e.g., calls that pass int literals or expect int return values).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template repository's StockIngredient use int for price to match the problem statement and the solution: change the field declaration to 'private final int price;', change the constructor signature to 'public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity)', and change getPrice() to return int. Update any code in the template that relies on double (if any) to use int. This preserves the intended API from the UML and the reference solution and avoids type mismatches for students.
